subject: website
name: Alcove
summary: Alcove, an RSS reader, open source (MIT). It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: when it opens it connects to its author's sync relays (relay.alcove.tools), and feeds are fetched through its author's proxies (proxy.alcove.tools), which see what you read.

connections.name: Feed proxies (proxy.alcove.tools, proxy2.alcove.tools)
connections.note: Every feed is fetched through them.
